backlogged.summary: Leftover blank lines where the local helpers were removed (lib/config.mjs, lib/eval-status.mjs, lib/events.mjs, lib/telemetry.mjs, lib/verify-cache.mjs) leave double blank lines. This is cosmetic.
lib/metrics.mjs re-exports median via `export { median }` and lib/learn.mjs wraps it as median2. Callers could import from util.mjs directly, which would drop the wrapper layers.
B382 (telemetry's own sha16) is resolved by this diff, since telemetry.mjs and events.mjs now import sha16 from util.mjs.
